ATTESTATION
I, WENADAYI WADUGE ANURA DHANARATNA of No.08, Jayanthipura Main
Road, Battaramulla in the Judicial Zone of Colombo in the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka, Notary Public do hereby certify and attest that the foregoing
instrument having been duly read over and explained by me the said Notary to
within-named executants, INDU SHYAMAL KUMARI KODAGODA who signed
illegibly and affixed her thumb of left hand impression (the said Transferor) and
WEDIPPULI ARACHCHIGE ISHANI PRASADINI DHEERASINGHE who signed
illegibly and affixed her thumb of left hand impression (the said Transferee) in the
presence of 1) Jayaweera Mudiyanselage Ruvinda Sasanka (holder of National
Identity Card No.199522700540) of No.143/3, Kingstone Court, Philip Mawatha,
Madulawa, Padukka who signed illegibly and 2) Hollu Pathirage Arosha Nisal
Caldera (holder of National Identity Card No.702554233 V and Driving License No.
B11099) of No.315, Subasadaka Mawatha, Hokandara South, Hokandara who signed
illegibly the subscribing Witnesses there to and they declare that they are well
acquainted with the executants and known their proper names, occupations and
residences and the same was signed by the said executants and the said witnesses and
by me the said Notary in my presence and in the presence of one another all being
presents together at the same time at Colombo as aforesaid on this Fourteenth (14th)
day of July Two Thousand and Twenty Five (2025).
I further certify that the first executant and first witness are not known to me and
second executant and second witness are not known to me and I have checked their
identity by the inspection of their national identity cards prior to the execution of the
foregoing instrument.
I further certify and attest that out the consideration hereof mentioned a sum of
Rupees Four Million Seven Hundred and Sixty Nine Thousand Five Hundred
(Rs.4,769,500/=) was paid by the cheque bearing No.008417 dated 14/07/2025 for
Rs.4,769,500/= drawn on Nations Trusts Bank at Battaramulla branch in favour of the
said Vendor in my presence. And the balance of Rupees Fifty Thousand (Rs.50,000/=)
was acknowledged to have been received by the said Vendor prior to the execution of
these presents.
I further certify and attest that the before the foregoing instrument was read over and
explained by me the said Notary to the within named executants as aforesaid that in
all Original, Duplicate and Protocol on page 03 in line 9 "to" was interpolated.
I certify that this instrument was attested by me in terms of Section 44 of
Registration of Title Act No.21 of 1998.
Date of Attestation
14th July 2025.
W.W.ANUR
DHANARATHA
LB (Sri
Attorney-at-Law
1
Notary Public
COLOMBO
WHICH I AFTEST
Notary Public.
